title: Rent record
lead: The months you paid on time, late or still owe, from payments getproperty confirmed. It is yours, shared only when you choose.
empty: No confirmed month yet. Months paid through getproperty appear here once their due date has passed.
notConfirmed: {count, plural, one {# more month was} other {# more months were}} paid in a way getproperty did not confirm (cash, for example) and are not counted.
footnote: Facts from payments, not a score. No amounts, no names of past landlords.

letter.title: Letter with a verification code
letter.body: A new landlord who does not use getproperty checks it with a 10-character code. Valid for 90 days; you can withdraw it any time.
letter.empty: You can create a letter once at least one month is confirmed.
letter.once: This code is shown only once. Copy it or send it to the landlord now.
letter.copyText: My rent record on getproperty — code {code}, check it at {url}

shares.title: What you shared
shares.stopBody: The owner will no longer see your record, and the letter code stops working at once.

enquiry.title: Share your rent record
enquiry.consent: I agree that the owner of this listing sees my rent record (months and their status, no amounts) until I stop sharing.
enquiry.shared: The owner can see your rent record.
